title: Match a named choice
summary: Scala: Match a named choice. Try yellow.
introduction: match checks cases from top to bottom. _ is a catch-all case.
learningObjectives: Match a named choice with Scala

blocks.text: Install Scala CLI. Save each example as lesson.scala and run scala run lesson.scala. These examples use Scala 3 syntax.

blocks.title: Match a named choice
blocks.code:
@main def lesson(): Unit =
  val light = "green"
  val message = light match
    case "red" => "Stop"
    case "green" => "Go"
    case _ => "Wait"
  println(message)

blocks.text: The green case matches Light and returns Go.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep case lines indented under match.
